title: 第20章 一只与众不同的鸡第21章 灰雾里行走的尸体
lines: 在大量的模拟实验下，苏午终于触发了这项天赋。
而当电子音响起的时候，他内心也笃定女孩一定会听从自己的‘指示’，到车上来。
他迅速将一排排蜡烛摆满控制台。
就等着将之点燃。
在前方，车灯照耀下，愣了刹那的女孩抱着她的‘应急罐头’，埋头走向了汽车的副驾驶位。
女孩拉开车门，坐在副驾驶位上，才发现身旁的男人执着而专注地将一根根蜡烛蹲在控制台。
左侧第一根蜡烛燃着橘色的火，在火苗映照下，她内心缓缓生出一丝安全感。
她刚想开口问询苏午这是在干什么。
苏午已然打断她，说道：“先不要说话！”
他言辞冷淡，吓得女孩蜷缩起了身子。
这时，一盏盏血红的灯笼从街道两旁的楼宇后冉冉升起，它们在天空中悠悠转动着，将暗蓝的夜空映成绯红。
灯笼连成天穹中的长河，绯红光芒洒落街区。
如此情景，竟是美轮美奂，让人如堕梦中。
而苏午身处这梦幻当中，却觉有一股寒意自尾椎骨生出，而后一路蔓延向头顶天灵！
他屏住了呼吸。
副驾驶的女子偷偷打量着苏午的侧脸，看着苏午渗出细汗的面孔上，凝重而执着的表情，亦不禁跟着紧张起来，连大气都不敢出一下。
女子亲眼见过了身边许多人的死亡。
看到他们的头颅飞起，飘向远处。
但这些人的头颅从未在她眼前变成过红灯笼，她也就很难将天上的灯笼，与死者的头颅联系起来。
或者说，她下意识地让自己不产生这种联想。
红光倾入了车窗里，洒在车内两个人的肩头。
苏午眼睛一眨不眨，凝视着蹲在控制台面上的那根红烛，红烛幽幽地燃烧着，丝毫没有加剧燃烧的迹象。
看到这一幕，他终于松了一口气。
蜡烛之所以没有加快燃烧，原因在于旁边女子怀里抱着的那只大公鸡！
大公鸡本身有种屏蔽或抗拒眼诡选中它周围的人，将人杀死的能力。
小庙里的火焰也有类似能力。
两者叠加起来，前者生效，后者就不会再另外消耗。
目前来看，呆在大公鸡周围三步以内就比较安全，超出这个距离，仍然会被眼诡选中。
就像上次，女孩因为惧怕自己，直往后退出了七八步，灯笼一升上天，第一时间就摘掉了她的脑袋。
此种能力是所有大公鸡都有吗？
还是只有女孩怀里这只公鸡与众不同？
苏午心思转动的同时，不忘记开动车子，向前行驶。
车辆徐徐加速，他放缓了语气，开口向旁边的女孩解释道：“你从别的地方走过来，应该也看到有人在你面前头颅像气球一样飞走了吧？”
回忆对女孩而言，很是不堪回首。
但面对苏午的询问，她依旧鼓起了勇气，回忆起先前所见所闻，眼眶微红，声音里带了一丝哭腔：“我不知道怎么回事，今天晚上天上突然出现好多红灯笼，我还在和妈妈说好漂亮好漂亮……
然后在厨房炒菜的爸爸就突然没声音了，他的头从厨房飘了过来，喊了妈妈一句……”
说着说着，女孩就泣不成声。
苏午把车开得飞快，在手机导航上将目的地设定会明州市郊的一个小汽车站，顺着导航给出的路线疾驰。
他听着女孩所言，想到这一切终究要在现实里发生，不可避免，又联想到自己父母亲的音容笑貌，顿时有些心酸。
“节哀。”
content_en:
After a lot of simulation experiments, Su Wu finally triggered this talent.
And when the electronic sound sounded, he was sure in his heart that the girl would follow his 'instructions' and come to the car.
He quickly filled the console with rows of candles.
Just waiting to ignite it.
In front, illuminated by the car lights, the girl who was stunned for a moment hugged her 'emergency can' and walked towards the passenger seat of the car.
The girl opened the car door and sat in the passenger seat, only to find that the man next to her was squatting on the console with candles persistently and intently.
The first candle on the left was burning with orange fire. Under the light of the flame, she slowly felt a sense of security in her heart.
"You..."
She was about to ask Su Wu what he was doing.
Su Wu had already interrupted her and said, "Don't talk yet!"
His cold words made the girl cower in fright.
At this time, blood-red lanterns slowly rose from behind the buildings on both sides of the street. They slowly rotated in the sky, reflecting the dark blue night sky into crimson.
The lanterns formed a long river in the sky, and crimson light fell on the streets.
Such a scene is so beautiful that it makes people feel like they are in a dream.
While Su Wu was in this dream, he felt a chill coming from his tailbone, and then spreading all the way to the heaven above his head!
He held his breath.
The woman in the co-pilot secretly looked at Su Wu's side face. Seeing the solemn and persistent expression on Su Wu's face that was dripping with sweat, she couldn't help but become nervous and didn't even dare to express her anger.
The woman has witnessed the death of many people around her.
See their heads flying up and floating into the distance.
But the heads of these people had never turned into red lanterns before her eyes, so it was difficult for her to connect the lanterns in the sky with the heads of the deceased.
In other words, she subconsciously prevented herself from making this association.
Red light poured into the car window and fell on the shoulders of the two people in the car.
Su Wu unblinking eyes stared at the red candle squatting on the console. The red candle was burning faintly, without any sign of intensifying the burning.
Seeing this scene, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
The reason why the candle did not burn faster was because of the big rooster in the arms of the woman next to her!
The big rooster itself has the ability to block or resist the eyes of the people around it, and kill them.
The flames in the small temple have similar abilities.
When the two are superimposed, the former takes effect and the latter will not be consumed separately.
At present, it is safer to stay within three steps of the big rooster. Beyond this distance, you will still be selected by the eyes.
Just like last time, the girl took seven or eight steps back because she was afraid of him. As soon as the lantern rose to the sky, her head was taken off as soon as possible.
Do all big cocks have this ability?
Or is it just the cock in the girl's arms that's different?
While Su Wu's mind was spinning, he didn't forget to start the car and drive forward.
The vehicle accelerated slowly, and he softened his tone and explained to the girl next to him: "You should have seen someone's head fly away like a balloon in front of you when you came from somewhere else, right?"
"...Yes."
The memories are very painful for girls.
But in the face of Su Wu's inquiry, she still mustered up her courage. Recalling what she had seen and heard before, her eyes were slightly red, and there was a hint of crying in her voice: "I don't know what happened, but there were so many red lanterns suddenly appearing in the sky tonight. I was still telling my mother how beautiful it is...
Then my father, who was cooking in the kitchen, suddenly became silent. His head floated over from the kitchen and called my mother..."
As she spoke, the girl burst into tears.
Su Wu drove the car very fast, set the destination on the mobile phone navigation to a bus station on the outskirts of Mingzhou, and drove along the route given by the navigation.
As he listened to what the girl said, he thought that all this would eventually happen in reality and that it was inevitable. He also thought of his parents' voices and smiles, and suddenly felt a little sad.
"Condolences."
